alt: 年輕講者依序指著廚餘分類、鋪乾葉、翻拌與施肥四張圖，對照桌上材料清楚解說，聽眾理解地點頭。
scene_prompt: Modern community gardening workshop. A young presenter explains composting in a very clear logical sequence, speaking calmly and pointing to four large picture-only cards arranged LEFT TO RIGHT: sort vegetable scraps, layer with dry leaves, turn mixture with small fork, use rich finished compost for seedling. Under each card on the table is the corresponding real material or demonstration tray, aligned exactly so listeners can easily follow the reasoning step by step. Three listeners nod with understanding, one compares same four pictures in a booklet with no writing. Emphasize organized coherent explanation rather than merely tidy objects or fast speech. Correct organic materials and compost stages, grounded trays, presenter two arms, natural five fingers, hand pointer contact, stable table perspective. Landscape 3:2 graphite watercolor colored pencil ivory paper; no readable words numerals labels arrows brands logos watermarks.
